name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text input. Auto-grows up to a cap; resize handle at bottom-right. Inherits the field shell from Input.

rows.description: Initial rows. Auto-grows past this if `field-sizing: content` is supported.

maxLength.description: Pair with a character counter in the trailing slot.

autoResize.description: Use field-sizing: content to auto-grow. Falls back to the user resize handle.

keyboard: Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter — optional submit when used in a Form context
rules: Always paired with a visible label via Field.
Character counter (if present) lives in the helper row, not in the trailing slot, so it doesn't compete for shell space.
Resize handle: vertical-only by default (resize: vertical). Use 'none' for fixed-height textareas; 'both' is discouraged because it breaks page rhythm.

do: Auto-grow with field-sizing: content when supported; fall back to user resize handle.
Cap auto-grow with max-height so a runaway textarea doesn't push the rest of the form off-screen.
Use a character counter for tweet-length / SMS-length / SEO meta-description fields.
dont: Don't allow horizontal resize on a multi-column form — it breaks the column rhythm.
Don't make a textarea the entire page — at that scale, use a dedicated editor.
Don't disable the resize handle without an alternative (e.g. auto-grow). Users need a way to see more text.

changelog.note: Initial release. Adopts the field shell, removes the v0.5 `text-base md:text-sm` font-size override, adds aria-invalid:focus-visible halo recipe to match Input.
